cases.name: script-runs-and-mutates-local-custom
cases.note: First fixture exercising SBPA ScriptTask → n8n code node. StartEvent (webhook) → Initialize Custom Data (code) → Script Task (code) → EndEvent (set). The script walks two parallel arrays from the trigger payload (`firstnames`, `lastnames`) and pushes concatenations into `custom.names`. Verifies (1) the `$.context.startEvent.<field>` → `$json.body.<field>` rewrite (webhook trigger wraps the payload in `body`), (2) the `$.context.custom.<field>` → local `custom.<field>` rewrite, and (3) that Initialize Custom Data seeds `custom.names` as `[]` from the DataObject's declared JSON Schema — without that seeding the script would crash on the first `.push()` (see graph.js:buildInitSetNode / seedLiteralFromSchema). Known limitation: the EndEvent output emits `names: []` rather than the concatenated list, because SBPA's `context.custom.<X>` resolver routes reads to `$('Initialize Custom Data').item.json.<X>` — reading Init's pristine state, not the ScriptTask's mutated `$json.custom`. The mutation is real (the ScriptTask returns `{ ...$json, custom }`) but nothing downstream reads that path yet. Ratchet EndEvent's `names` assertion to `["AdaLovelace", "AlanTuring", "GraceHopper"]` once the resolver learns to route custom reads through the propagated `$json.custom.<X>` (or once ScriptTasks write their mutated custom back into the Initialize Custom Data node's slot, which n8n can't do retroactively).
